newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices steady in dull trade.

text.p: * Indian government security prices steady in dull noon trade on Thursday, dealers said.
* Market attention remains focussed on short- and medium-term stocks, they said.
* "Trading banks are not as active as they were in April when call money was below 1.0 percent," said a dealer at a state-run bank. Call money traded around 7.5 percent in noon trade Thursday.
"While call money has stabilised, it will require a drop
in rates for trading to pick up again," the dealer said.
* In latest deals, 12.69 percent 2002 stock traded at 100.22 rupees against last traded 100.24, 13.85 percent 2000 up at 105.62 from 105.60 and 13.70 percent 1999 steady at 104.85.
